outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and aligns with the drawer handle in frames 0–64, then closes its gripper around it in frames 65–74 (wrist_image and left_ego_image). The drawer visibly moves outward during frames 91–120, exposing its interior and side rails (image and wrist_image). It remains open as the gripper releases and withdraws in frames 121–137 (image and wrist_image). No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or disturbance of unrelated objects is visibly established.
